title: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers — November 2026 final (10:00 ET), pulled a week forward out of Thanksgiving week
source: EST: the publisher's own 2026 release-date schedule, fetched direct 2026-09-09 — data.sca.isr.umich.edu/fetchdoc.php?docid=79628 (HTTP 200, 132,710 bytes, the PDF linked as `2026 Release Dates` from data.sca.isr.umich.edu/survey-info.php, HTTP 200). Its table reads `November 6 | November Prelim` and `November 20 | November Final`, alongside all twelve months. Reconciled against the calendar's two existing entries for this publisher: the same document's `September 11 | September Prelim` and `September 25 | September Final` rows match umich-sentiment-prelim-2026-09-11 and umich-sentiment-final-2026-09-25 exactly, which is the check that this PDF is the live schedule and not a stale draft. Publisher's own front page (sca.isr.umich.edu, HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-09) independently confirms the next release as `Friday, September 11, 2026 for Preliminary September data at 10am ET`, which is where the 10:00 ET time comes from. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit — the CONFIRMED_PREFIX taxonomy does carry `UMICH:`, so this is a self-confirm limit and not a taxonomy gap, and a second look by this event's own lane could promote it. Discovered 2026-09-09 in the never-assessed initial research of case-shiller-hpi-2026-11-24
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the case-shiller-hpi-2026-11-24 never-assessed initial research, at D-76 of its own print. WHY IT IS A GAP: the calendar tracks exactly two University of Michigan entries, both September 2026 (prelim 09-11, final 09-25), so every later month of a twice-monthly series that the Conference Board's own confidence print is read against is missing. This one is inside the five-day corridor of the proposing event (four days before) and lands on opex-2026-11-20, already tracked. WHY IT IS THE ONE THIS LANE PROPOSES RATHER THAN THE WHOLE SERIES: it carries the proposing ledger's own comparative finding. UMich's 2026 schedule moves its November final to the 20th rather than the last Friday (the 27th, a half day) and its December final to the 18th rather than the 25th — this publisher writes holiday weeks out of its calendar. S&P DJI's `last Tuesday of each month` rule has no holiday carve-out at all, which is why case-shiller-hpi-2026-11-24 sits inside Thanksgiving week and case-shiller-hpi-2026-12-29 inside Christmas week. Two publishers, the same two holidays, opposite policies — and it is a candidate mechanism for the empirical December move the fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 lane observed for a third. NOT PROPOSED, AND THE REASON IS RECORDED: umich-sentiment-prelim-2026-11-06 is equally derivable from the same primary and equally missing, but it sits 18 days from the proposing event and outside its corridor; backfilling a twice-monthly series from one lane is not adjacency.
